name: Blocks Monster
author: blocksmonster

sections.description:
Blocks Monster is the #1 library of reusable blocks with 2,745+ downloads 🚀

How to use

  1. Install the Blocks Monster plugin.
  2. Go to the Gutenberg editor.
  3. Add a new block.

Bug reports

Bug reports for “Blocks Monster” are welcomed in WordPress support forum.

Further reading

For more info check out the following:

  • The blocks.monster official website 📌
  • The Contact us 👋
  • All other my WordPress plugins 💎
  • Contribute with plugin contact us ✨
sections.installation: 1. Install the Blocks Monster plugin either via the WordPress plugin directory, or by uploading the files to your server at wp-content/plugins.
